svg.text: AWS WAF: 403 above 300 requests per 5 min per IP, lifted in about 5 min
Cognito: sign-up disabled, /v1 without an access token gets 401
Internal ALB: only the CloudFront VPC origin security group
Gateway NLB: only the batch client security group
Qwen pod: NetworkPolicy allows gateway, EPP, and wake API only
Web search: BFF pod role only, no tool on sensitive requests

Seoul Region, two g6e.4xlarge and one g6.xlarge. Steps 0~4 measured 2026-11-14, step 5 and the segment table 2026-11-15. Steps 1~4: Gemma cold start, baseline and optimized. Step 5: Gemma and Qwen. Web search: range of 6 us-east-1 calls from the work machine (Seoul)
